releaseNotes:
1. Printer Persistence & Kiosk Sync: Added dedicated Save Printer Settings button in Settings, binding selected receipt and barcode printers directly to Windows spooler and Chromium kiosk profiles.
2. Thermal Print Direct Routing: Removed hardcoded printer fallbacks, ensuring billing receipts print instantly to the user-configured printer.
3. Multi-Terminal Sync: Full release v2.4.8 available for all network counters and terminals.
